description: This file contains implementation code for iterating over and managing compressed bitmap data structures using the EWAH (Efficient Word-Aligned Hybrid) compression technique. It defines functions for initializing iterators, advancing through compressed data, and discharging compressed words into a bitmap.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next compressed word in the bitmap buffer, updating iterator state accordingly.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes the iterator to start processing a given ewah_bitmap, setting up buffer references and loading the first word.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Skips a specified number of words in the compressed bitmap, adjusting internal state to move past them.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Decompresses words from the iterator into an output ewah_bitmap, up to a maximum number of words, applying negation if specified.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
